notes: Five prompts should route to this skill and five are adjacent but out of scope, so both over-triggering and under-triggering are measurable.
Each probe runs with read-only tools in an empty directory. The routing decision is made from the description before any file is read, so the absence of a real repository does not affect it.
A probe is correct when the skill fired and was expected to, or did not fire and was not expected to.

prompts.prompt: Turn on secret scanning and push protection for this repository.
Add a ruleset that blocks force pushes to main and requires one approving review.
Audit who has admin access to our repository, deploy keys included.
We want to make this private repository public next week. What has to happen first?
Add a SECURITY.md and enable private vulnerability reporting on the repo.
Pin every action in our CI workflow to a commit SHA.
Require two-factor authentication for every member of our GitHub organization.
Write a pull request description for the changes on this branch.
Set up a protected branch for main in our GitLab project.
Explain how git rebase differs from git merge.
